annotation.title_clean: FIJI: Leading the Pacific Islands: building a national science and research ecosystem for the age of artificial intelligence
annotation.title_en: FIJI: Leading the Pacific Islands: building a national science and research ecosystem for the age of artificial intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Forbes, K.; Brimble, P.; Bin Zaid, H.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Country chapter on Fiji's AI and science ecosystem, prepared for the International Science Council. It covers the AI Hub, the National Digital Strategy 2025–2030, infrastructure, skills and funding gaps, and the lack of AI-specific law. It recommends finalising an AI ethics framework, investing in computing, building talent and collaborating regionally.
key_provisions_or_claims: Fiji launched an AI Hub in 2024 and approved the National Digital Strategy 2025–2030.
Fiji has a Data Protection Act but no AI-specific laws on accountability, bias or safety.
The government plans an AI user protection framework.
Capacity, computing infrastructure and dedicated funding are the main barriers.
Next steps: finalise an AI ethics framework, invest in infrastructure, retain talent and collaborate regionally.
